profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the internet industry. Skilled in Python, Computer Science, C++, Databases, and Java. Strong engineering professional with a Undergraduate focused in Computer Science from University of California, San Diego.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
Assisted with programming courses Introduction to Computer Science: Java and Computer Organization & Systems Programming. Responsibilities included holding lab hours, answering discussion board questions, grading assignments, and proctoring examinations.

CSE 8A: Intro Computer Science: Java I

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on the Instagram iOS team doing client-side programming in Objective-C. Tasks included updating the creative tools’ adjust page, fixing client-side bugs, and working on the caption editing feature.

positions.title: Facebook Campus Ambassador for UCSD
positions.description: Worked as liaison between the UC: San Diego campus and Facebook’s university relations. Responsibilities included organizing and hosting on-campus events and also collecting resumes from potential interns and full-time employees

positions.title: Facebook University Intern
positions.description: Developed Localize, an iOS application that allows people to chat with others in the same area, while being able to control how close others need to be to chat with them.

positions.title: Computer Science Summer Institute
positions.description: Acquired skills in Python, HTML, CSS, and Javascript, while performing back-end programming in conjunction with Google App Engine to develop a web application

projects.title: Gif.it
projects.description: With a team of two other Google Computer Science Summer Institute participants, worked on Gif.it, a web application that allows users to create gifs from multiple image files.
